scooter.guide.basics.0: Place: right-click a block with the scooter item. Ride: right-click the placed scooter.
scooter.guide.basics.1: W accelerates; S brakes without reversing. Hold the sprint key (Ctrl by default) while turning for an easy drift.
scooter.guide.basics.2: Your inventory key (E by default) opens your normal inventory with Settings and Help buttons. Storage and Music are there too.
scooter.guide.basics.3: Space jumps. Wind charges in your hotbar give a stronger jump; one charge is consumed outside Creative.
scooter.guide.basics.4: Right-click with a firework while riding for 20 seconds of nitro. Hold Space during nitro to thrust upward.
scooter.guide.basics.5: Shift dismounts. Shift + right-click an empty personal scooter picks it up, keeping upgrades and storage.
scooter.guide.basics.6: Recall (R by default) needs a Nether Star bound scooter and Loyalty. Leave inventory space; occupied scooters cannot be recalled.
scooter.guide.basics.7: Keys can be changed in Controls. /scootersettings opens Settings; /scooterhelp opens this guide. Rentals have different rules: pay poker chips; Shift + right-click destroys them.
scooter.guide.upgrades.0: Use a smithing table. Leave the template slot empty, put your scooter in the middle and the upgrade item on the right. The preview and tooltip show installed upgrades.
scooter.guide.upgrades.1: Chest: adds 27 storage slots. Press E, then Storage; contents stay when picked up.
scooter.guide.upgrades.2: Note block: enables server WAV songs. Open Music from the scooter menu, search and choose a song. Stop ends playback.
scooter.guide.upgrades.3: Jukebox: enables music discs. Right-click the scooter with a disc, then use Play disc / Stop in Music.
scooter.guide.upgrades.4: Nether Star: binds the scooter to its owner and protects it, including from the void. Only the owner can drive; enabled passenger seats stay open to others. Loyalty enables recall.
scooter.guide.upgrades.5: Netherite block: flight upgrade, 180 km/h, slow descent and stronger air steering. Above 100 km/h it steps over obstacles up to 3 blocks.
scooter.guide.upgrades.6: Paint: combine the scooter and a dye in crafting. Armor trims use normal smithing templates and materials; paint and trims work together.
scooter.guide.upgrades.7: Upgrades combine and retain enchantments and storage. An installed upgrade cannot be installed twice. Flight upgrades cannot be added to rentals.
scooter.guide.enchants.0: Enchant the scooter at an enchanting table or with enchanted books in an anvil. Only supported enchantments are accepted.
scooter.guide.enchants.1: Efficiency raises normal top speed. Quick Charge improves acceleration. Sweeping Edge improves steering.
scooter.guide.enchants.2: Frost Walker makes temporary water and lava paths. Feather Falling protects you after dismounting.
scooter.guide.enchants.3: Wind Burst adds jump height. Lunge enables a forward burst by double-tapping W, with a short cooldown.
scooter.guide.enchants.4: Loyalty enables recall for a Nether Star bound scooter. Recall will not steal an occupied scooter.
scooter.guide.enchants.5: Piercing damages entities on impact. Knockback pushes them farther away.
scooter.guide.enchants.6: Density reduces sliding and strengthens braking. Unsupported enchantments such as Mending and Unbreaking are not accepted.
scooter.guide.enchants.7: Soul Speed helps on soul blocks. Depth Strider improves travel through water.
scooter.guide.enchants.8: Use the scooter tooltip to see its installed smithing upgrades, trim and enchantments.
scooter.guide.enchants.9: Switch camera effects and sound levels in Settings if you prefer a calmer ride.
scooter.inventory.settings_tip: Mouse steering, camera effects, headlights and sound levels.
scooter.inventory.help_tip: Riding controls, upgrade recipes, music and recall.
scooter.inventory.storage_missing: Add a chest at a smithing table to unlock storage.
scooter.inventory.music_tip: Choose server songs or music discs. Requires a note block or jukebox upgrade.
scooter.parking.fine: No-parking zone: rental destroyed, 100-chip fine and 5 damage. Unpaid chips are collected from future credit.
scooter.jei.enchant.density: Density: stronger braking and less drifting.
scooter.jei.enchant.frost_walker: Frost Walker: makes temporary paths across source water and lava; stay near the surface.
scooter.jei.enchant.feather_falling: Feather Falling: protects you after dismounting or landing.
scooter.jei.enchant.depth_strider: Depth Strider: stronger acceleration through water.
scooter.jei.enchant.soul_speed: Soul Speed: faster over soul sand and soul soil.
scooter.jei.enchant.piercing: Piercing: deals impact damage proportional to speed (2 per level at 52 km/h; up to 40).
scooter.jei.enchant.knockback: Knockback: knocks hit players and mobs over, with the rental trip effect.
scooter.jei.enchant.wind_burst: Wind Burst: higher jumps with wind charges in the hotbar.
scooter.jei.enchant.loyalty: Loyalty: recall your soul-bound scooter with the recall key or /scooterrecall.
scooter.jei.enchant.breach: Breach: at 60 km/h or faster, breaks walls only one block thick and preserves momentum. Server cooldown defaults to 5 seconds. Protected blocks and containers are excluded.
scooter.jei.enchant.lunge: Lunge: double-tap forward for a short acceleration burst with a sound and FOV kick.
scooter.guide.upgrades.8: Saddle: adds a passenger behind the driver. The owner can disable the seat in Settings.
scooter.guide.enchants.10: Breach: breaks one-block-thick walls at 60+ km/h, preserving momentum. Default cooldown: 5 seconds; the server can change it.
scooter.guide.basics.8: Rentals start at 20–49% battery. A red parking icon marks forbidden biomes. Dismounting there destroys the rental, costs 100 chips and deals 5 damage.
